parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the mug is the main cylindrical container made of ceramic, designed to hold liquids such as coffee or tea.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary vessel for containing the beverage, providing thermal insulation and structural support.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move independently; it supports the handle and lid.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched extension attached to the side of the mug body, made of ceramic.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to comfortably hold and lift the mug without touching the hot surface of the body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a detachable cover made of plastic that fits on top of the mug.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents spills, retains heat, and can include an opening for drinking.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or rotated to open or close the mug.
